name: vm-supplier-mobile-ui
description: Vayalavan Supplier — the Android/iOS supplier app. Feature parity with vm-supplier-ui.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT a member of the root npm workspaces. Expo pins its own React (19.1 here) and the three web UIs are on React 18.3; hoisting both into one root node_modules gives npm a choice it resolves silently and differently on every machine. A separate install here costs disk and buys a lockfile that means what it says. See README.md 'Why this is not an npm workspace'.
//sdk: Pinned to Expo SDK 54 because that is the newest SDK the App Store and Play Store builds of Expo Go support — Expo stopped publishing Expo Go to the stores after 54, and later builds exist only as GitHub artefacts (an APK, and a simulator-only .app for iOS). On iOS there is no sideload path at all, so a newer SDK means no Expo Go on a real iPhone. See README.md 'Why SDK 54'. Change these versions only as a set, via `npx expo install --fix`.

scripts.//port: Metro's default 8081 is vm-profile-api's port. Prefer `make -C infra mobile`, which reads MOBILE_METRO_PORT from the root .env; these are the fallback for running from this directory.
